newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong stocks end sharply up, HSBC hits record.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks end sharply up, HSBC hits record.

text.p: Late buying boosted Hong Kong stocks to a sharply higher close on Friday, with record highs in HSBC Holdings and Henderson Land shares buoying the Hang Seng index through resistance, analysts said.
The Hang Seng index closed above the 11,300 point level at 11,369.04, up 117.32 points. Turnover jumped to HK$5.31 billion from HK$4.41 billion on Thursday.
"People were buying more aggressively in the afternoon and pushing prices up," said Frederick Tsang, head of research at PrimeEast Securities.
HSBC closed at a record high of HK$137.50, up HK$2.00.
The stock hit an intra-day record high of HK$138.00.
"Hongkong bank is actually very strong. People are bullish on the index and they might also think the U.K. market might perform better which helps the performance of HSBC," said Tsang.
The FTSE 100 index hit a new record high at Friday's opening, rising 4.8 points to 3,937.4.
Henderson Land closed at a record HK$63.50, up HK$1.75.
"After Henderson Land's results, everyone feels very confident that the market for residential property is seeing an increase in demand," said Miles Remington, sales trader at Crosby Securities.

Swire Properties said on Thursday it was adding 64 units to the 48 already on offer in its pre-sale of flats at its Island Place Development. New World Development added 298 units to the original 98 units on offer at its Discovery Park residential development in Hong Kong's Tsuen Wan.
Swire Pacific shares closed the session down HK$0.50 at HK$68.25 but New World Development added HK$0.30 to HK$38.50.
"There is surging interest in the mass residential market," said Tsang. "Property stocks are very strong mainly because of the good response to a few property pre-sales."
Sun Hung Kai Properties rose HK$1.00 to HK$77.25 and Cheung Kong rose HK$0.50 to HK$55.75.
"I think you are going to continue to see these (property) stocks outperforming in very short-term," said Remington.
Analysts said Thursday's U.S. tame wholesale inflation report had calmed interest rate fears in the market, which had helped local stocks start the session on a firm note.
They said if U.S. August consumer price data, due later on Friday, showed inflation was under control, the Hang Seng index could approach its year high of 11,600 in the near term.
